newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares active as index takes a breather.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares active as index takes a breather.

text.p: Estonian shares remained active on Wednesday but the bourse index took a breather after a hectic few days of gains.
The overall activity on the main official list was 13.8 million kroons but the Tallinn stock exchange index dipped 0.37 percent to 104.48.

Market leader Hansapank was the most active stock on trade of 3.9 million kroons and it ended at 105 kroons after 105.25 yesterday while Tallinna Pank turned over 3.2 million kroons of shares and closed at 40.10 after 39.85 on Tuesday.
The free market, where over-the-counter trades take place, also had healthy activity of 11.4 million kroons with the Rakevere meat factory again dominating trade.
It saw volume of 6.2 million kroons and closed at six kroons, a further rise from 5.20 kroons on Tuesday.
